messages:
Alyssa (CSM): @here quick heads-up — PraxisMD is kicking off APAC pilot tomorrow and they're hitting 429s in our ap-southeast-1 edge. They need a temporary throughput bump and IP allowlist for 10 days. Renewal call in ~3 weeks; success here ties directly to expansion. Can we get a short-term rate increase + add their CIDR to allowlist? Details below.

Maria (Onboarding): Thanks — do we have the org/account id and current plan? Also any logs or sample requests so eng can size the bump?

Alyssa (CSM): Org: praxismd-prod (acct_1293). Plan: Hosted Growth. Saw spikes during data ingestion -> burst to ~120 RPS per API key. Error snapshot:
```
{"status":429, "message":"rate limit exceeded", "retry_after_ms": 1200}
```
IPs seen on logs: 203.0.113.45 and 203.0.113.46. Business ask: enable ap-southeast-1, add CIDR 203.0.113.0/28 to allowlist, increase per-key RPS from 10->80 for 10 days, and temporary per-org burst to 200 RPS.

Ben (Infra): Noted. Quick validation: hosted pools in ap-southeast-1 can handle an extra 200 RPS but we'd prefer a targeted burst policy vs changing global quotas. Suggest: create a short-lived policy for acct_1293 with per-key rps=80 and org-burst=200, TTL 10d. I'll need the requestor's support contact for audit record.

Devon (NetOps): For allowlist, I need the final CIDR and whether they require static NATs. If it's just those two IPs we can do /32 entries. If they own a range, provide ASN or confirmation. Also any inbound firewall changes? We only need the external egress IPs.

Alyssa (CSM): I'll confirm with PraxisMD — they asked us to use 203.0.113.40/28 as the agreed block. Support contact: mona@praxismd.com. No extra inbound firewall changes on our side.

Sam (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session (APAC-friendly window) to walk PraxisMD through SDK retries/backoff and caching tips to reduce burstiness. Also capturing feedback: can we add a short NPS/feedback form post-pilot? If they like perf, renewal likely upsell.

Ben (Infra): I'll draft the policy and post the deploy plan here. Plan: create policy CS_TEMP_BURST_acct1293, apply to ap-southeast-1 only, rps_per_key=80, org_burst=200, TTL=10d. Will validate tokens aren't over-provisioned.

deploybot: Ticket CS-3982 created: "PraxisMD APAC temporary throughput + allowlist" — https://redwood/tools/tickets/CS-3982

Devon (NetOps): Added note: we'll log access and rotate audit keys after TTL expires. Also tagging SES for billing delta.

Alyssa (CSM): Thanks team! I'll get confirmation from PraxisMD and post final CIDR. Renewal manager pinged. :rocket:

Mona (PraxisMD): @Alyssa thanks — confirmed 203.0.113.40/28. Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll join the enablement session on Thu 03:00 UTC. :pray:

Sam (Solutions): Great — I've booked Thu 03:00 UTC and sent calendar invites. Agenda: SDK retries, batching, token hygiene, success metrics. Sam will take notes.

Ben (Infra): Rolling out policy tonight at 23:30 UTC after quick smoke tests. Will report back status here.

deploybot: Deployment succeeded: CS_TEMP_BURST_acct1293 applied 2026-10-04T23:37:05Z :white_check_mark:

Alyssa (CSM): Verified with PraxisMD — 0 429s after bump, they saw latency improve. Marking this pilot as green for renewals follow-up. Capturing feedback in CS-3982.

Maria (Onboarding): Nice. I'll add a post-mortem checklist to the ticket: lessons learned, docs updated, and recommended permanency options if they want to keep it.

Alyssa (CSM): Thanks all. :tada:
